messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of eval runs from last night have missing per-sample fields in the traces (dashboard shows N/A for reference-based metrics). e.g. several entries lack `reference_output` and `system_prompt_hash`

kevin: oof. do we have an example trace blob? can we validate upload side? :eyes:

maria: here's a minimal snippet from S3 (gzipped but pasted after decompress):
```json
{"sample_id": "s-3234", "model": "rw-1.3-q4", "logprobs": [...], "output": "..."}
```
(note: no `reference_output`, no `meta.system_prompt_hash`, no `eval_seed`)

anika: that explains metric pipeline failing — the eval aggregator expects `reference_output` to compute exact-match/f1 and our dashboard hides the metric when it's missing. are these traces from quantized runner only?

maria: mostly quantized bring-ups from yesterday. I suspect the quant runner's trace-enrichment step crashed quietly and the uploader retried without enrichment. `trace-uploader-bot` posted a 413 once but then retried.

trace-uploader-bot: upload failed: 413 Request Entity Too Large; retried with chunked multipart -> final status: success, but missing enrichment step "post_enrich" reported in logs.

kevin: we should add a simple contract check in CI for traces (pre-commit or pre-upload validation). propose JSONSchema like: 
```json
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "required": ["sample_id","model","output","reference_output","meta"],
  "properties": {"meta": {"required": ["system_prompt_hash","eval_seed","trace_schema_version"]}}
}
```
If upload fails validation, fail the eval-runner CI job.

anika: yes but we still need a migration/backfill for runs already in S3. two parts: 1) mark incomplete traces so dashboards can ignore them explicitly; 2) backfill where possible (e.g., reference_output exists in artifact-store or old index). TTL/retention question: are we ok to keep incomplete traces for 30d then drop? or should we keep 180d for audit?

julius: per compliance we want 180 days. but to save cost, compress/anonymize incomplete ones and put them under `s3://redwood-eval-incomplete/yyyy-mm/` with lifecycle policy to Glacier after 30 days. owners for S3 policy change: eng-infra + eng-ml.

maria: suggested action list: 
- add JSONSchema validator to eval-runner uploader (CI gating) -> owner: @kevin
- add `trace_schema_version` header/metadata on S3 objects (uploader) -> owner: @maria
- backfill script to reconcile missing `reference_output` from artifact-index -> owner: @julius
- dashboard: show explicit "incomplete trace" badge instead of N/A -> owner: @anika
- retention policy: compress incomplete, move to `.../incomplete/` + lifecycle 180d/Glacier -> owner: eng-infra

kevin: I'll open a small PR today to wire the validator into the eval-runner CI. test plan: a unit test with 3 sample traces (good, missing-ref, missing-meta) and assert upload rejected for the latter two. CI failure message will link to migration doc.

anika: for dashboards I'll add a feature flag behind `eval_ui.show_incomplete_traces` so we can deploy quickly without changing queries. will add a tooltip explaining the badge.

julius: backfill plan: scan `s3://redwood-eval-raw/` for traces where `reference_output` missing, try to join by `sample_id` against `artifact-index` (fast lookup). if found, stitch and re-upload (with `trace_schema_version=v2`). will batch by date. estimate ~4 hours dev + 2h infra perms.

ci-bot: [pipeline] eval-runner-integration: FAILED on branch feature/quant-traces (see logs)

maria: noted. we should also add a short-term dashboard alert when >1% traces in a day are incomplete so oncall notices.

kevin: adding a pre-upload `--validate` flag to the uploader binary too; running locally will give clearer errors before CI. snippet: `uploader validate trace.json --schema schemas/trace-v2.json`

anika: +1 for the alert. dashboard alert -> owner: analytics -> I'll add a ticket.

julius: pinging eng-infra for lifecycle rule and cross-account role to run backfill. @eng-infra can you assign?

maria: ok owners confirmed. I'll write a short runbook for when backfill hits ambiguous joins (prefer manual review). target timeline: validator PR in today, uploader metadata + dashboard badges EOW, backfill early next week. :shipit:

kevin: lgtm. will create PR and link this thread. :thumbsup:

anika: thanks all. good call catching this before more models roll out.

trace-uploader-bot: note: upcoming change will add `x-amz-meta-trace-schema: v2` on next uploads.
